faq.q: What is a titanium surgical retractor blade?
faq.a: A titanium surgical retractor blade is a precision-machined surgical instruments component used in lightweight surgical retractor blade. Manufactured from Grade 9 Ti-3Al-2.5V for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: How is titanium surgical retractor blade sterilized?
faq.a: Titanium Surgical Retractor Blade is compatible with all standard sterilization methods: autoclave (134C steam), ethylene oxide (EtO), gamma radiation, and hydrogen peroxide plasma. Titanium's passive oxide layer remains stable through repeated sterilization cycles.

faq.q: How is titanium surgical retractor blade manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Surgical Retractor Blade is manufactured using VAR melting. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium surgical retractor blade?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
